interactive.label: Open TTTR files
interactive.tooltip: Choose one or more photon measurement files.

interactive.label: Add TTTR folder
interactive.tooltip: Add supported photon measurements from a folder.

interactive.label: MMFDB datasets
interactive.tooltip: Browse database measurements and resolve their local paths.

interactive.label: Clear files
interactive.tooltip: Remove loaded files and analysis results.

interactive.label: Channel definition
interactive.tooltip: Open the complete detector setup, timing, calibration, PIE, TAC and optical editor.

interactive.label: Stop computation
interactive.tooltip: Cancel at the next file boundary and retain the previous results.

interactive.label: min_photons
interactive.tooltip: Burst-search minimum photons. Photons NOT in a burst are treated as background/scatter.

interactive.label: photon_window
interactive.tooltip: Sliding photon window used by the burst search to estimate the local count rate.

interactive.label: baseline_quantile
interactive.tooltip: Quantile of the non-burst micro-time histogram taken as the flat dark-count floor, subtracted before normalising the IRF.

interactive.label: micro_time_binning
interactive.tooltip: Micro-time coarsening for the MLE IRF/background patterns (match the burst-MLE binning).

interactive.label: 🌙 Compute
interactive.tooltip: Extract the instrument response (IRF) and the per-detector background rates from the loaded files.

interactive.label: 🎯 Send to MLE
interactive.tooltip: Send the extracted IRF and background patterns to the burst-MLE lifetime fit.

interactive.label: Export MLE patterns
interactive.tooltip: Save per-detector IRF and background patterns in a NumPy archive for scripted MLE fitting.

interactive.label: 📖 Guide
interactive.tooltip: Start a step-by-step guided tour of this tool.

interactive.label: ❓ Help
interactive.tooltip: Open the help window with reference documentation.
